[[Image:EarlSawyer.png|thumb]]
'''Earl Sawyer''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Whateley Farm]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Fight]]
*+1 [[Sneak]]

Any Phase: [[Exhaust]] instead of losing 1 [[Stamina]].  Discard Earl Sawyer if the [[Ancient One]] awakens.

==Mythos Source==
Sawyer appears in ''The Dunwich Horror'' (1928), written by H.P. Lovecraft, as a villager who helps tend the livestock at the Whateley farm and who is suspicious of the events that he sees.
